title: Lead form — every field, empty and extreme values

steps.expect: Refused with a sentence naming what is missing (at least the company). No lead is created.
steps.observed: Refused, no lead created, still on the form: "Nothing has been saved — Company or person still needs filling in."

steps.expect: Saved (cut to the allowed length) or refused with a clear message — never a blank or error page.
steps.observed: Saved; the company name is kept at 200 characters (cut).

steps.do: Company name with special characters: "Shri Ram & Sons (P) Ltd. — युनिट २".
steps.expect: Saved and shown exactly as typed everywhere (list, detail, quote).
steps.observed: Shown exactly as typed on the lead, in the lead list and on the quotation made from it.

steps.expect: Shown as plain text; no bold, no pop-up. On the hosted site the server's own firewall may refuse the save with a plain "403 Forbidden" page before it reaches the app — that is the host protecting you, and also a pass (owner, 12 Nov 2026).
steps.observed: Saved and shown as plain text "Bold " on the lead, the list and the board — no bold, no pop-up.

steps.expect: The browser or the page refuses it with a message.
steps.observed: Refused: the browser says "Please enter a part following '@'. 'ravi@' is incomplete.".

steps.expect: Refused, or saved as 0 with a message — record what happens.
steps.observed: Refused: the browser says "Value must be greater than or equal to 0.".

steps.expect: Saved and shown with Indian grouping, not in scientific form.

steps.do: Expected to close = a date in 2019.
steps.expect: Accepted, but the lead shows as overdue on the board.
steps.observed: Accepted; on the board the card reads "TB Old Close Co L-2026-0005 0 ⏰ close date passed".

steps.do: Type of deputation = "Man-month (site deputation)", How many people = 0.
steps.expect: Refused or warned; never a lead for zero people without a message.
